verdict.rationale: Workable markets a built-in "Workable Agent" that takes over top-of-funnel work: it sources, screens and qualifies candidates against the spec, then hands back an interview-ready shortlist. AI search and AI-generated candidate recommendations add to this, but delegation is evidenced only for sourcing and screening, and only through a single marketing line. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating arbitrary tasks (e.g. scheduling, offers, reporting), documentation of how users assign and supervise agent tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
